comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: Excellent overview of the geology, geography, animals, plants ,cultural and political history of this part of North America. Where others generate heat, you produce light. The great assertion that all people are created equal is the quintessence of the American experiment, and you have addressed its central role commendably.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Thank you - that's exactly the balance we aim for on a topic this layered: light over heat.
